anatomy.demo: StructureContextEvidenceTrust

parts.desc: 通过清楚导航和栏目分层组织复杂业务内容
parts.desc_en: Clear navigation and content levels for a complex offer

parts.desc: 用真实角色、场地和任务说明产品在哪里产生价值
parts.desc_en: Real roles, environments, and tasks that show where the product creates value

parts.desc: 数据、案例和能力描述共同支撑主张
parts.desc_en: Data, cases, and capability descriptions that make each claim credible

parts.desc: 安全、合规、支持和实施方式降低采购风险
parts.desc_en: Security, compliance, support, and implementation details that lower buying risk

use.t: B2B 软件、工业、金融和专业服务：信任成本高于冲动转化
产品涉及多个行业或角色：需要用稳定导航组织复杂内容
采购由多人共同决定：案例、安全和服务信息需要同时到位
品牌需要跨地区长期使用：系统化布局更容易扩展语言和业务线

dont.t: 只写宏大口号：领先、协同、重塑未来如果没有证据，几乎没有信息量
把首页做成组织架构图：部门视角不等于客户解决问题的路径
所有内容都用深蓝方块：专业感来自秩序，不来自一种颜色铺满页面
案例只有客户 Logo：需要补充问题、过程和可理解的结果

principles.t: 先建立信息架构，再做视觉：产品、行业、资源和公司信息必须容易找到
关键主张配证据：数字、认证、客户案例和服务范围要具体可核验
用真实业务场景替代通用素材：让访客看见自己的行业和工作环境
专业不等于僵硬：排版、摄影和动效仍可表达品牌，只是不能妨碍理解

entry.prompt: 为一家工业数据服务商做企业官网。让采购、行业方案和安全能力都容易找到，用已授权客户案例、服务范围和可核验信息建立信任；使用真实工作场景，不要用空泛的商务口号。只采用我现有的资料，缺少的案例、认证或数字先标为“待补充”，并列出需要我提供的材料，不要自行补造。
entry.prompt_en: B2B corporate website, stable grid and clear multi-level navigation, deep navy and warm white palette, authentic industry photography, specific metrics, customer stories, security certification and service capability, restrained and premium without generic corporate stock imagery

en.prompt: B2B corporate website, stable grid and clear multi-level navigation, deep navy and warm white palette, authentic industry photography, specific metrics, customer stories, security certification and service capability, restrained and premium without generic corporate stock imagery

use.t: B2B software, industry, finance, and professional services where trust matters more than impulse
Products serving several industries or roles that require durable navigation for complex content
Purchases involving several stakeholders, where cases, security, and support need equal visibility
Brands operating across markets that need a layout system able to scale across languages and business lines

dont.t: Rely on grand claims: leading, empowering, and transforming say little without evidence
Turn the homepage into an org chart; internal departments are not the customer's problem-solving path
Put every section in a dark blue box; order creates professionalism, not one color alone
Treat a logo wall as a complete case study; explain the problem, work, and understandable outcome

principles.t: Design the information architecture first: products, industries, resources, and company information must be easy to find
Support every claim with evidence: use verifiable numbers, certifications, customer outcomes, and service scope
Use real operating context instead of generic business imagery so visitors can recognize their work
Professional does not mean rigid: type, photography, and motion can express a brand without slowing understanding
